game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Read n. Display Above when n > 3; otherwise display At or below. Test dataset 8: {'n': 1}; {'n': 6}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Cast Forge' (Week 2 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Charred Forest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the smelter using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the smelter is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Type Cast Forge – Charred Forest Trial
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
